skills.label: Enable Claude Science
skills.desc: Claude Science is a desktop app for scientific research.

skills.label: How Claude Science works with your data
skills.desc: What Claude Science keeps on your computers, what it sends to Anthropic and how long Anthropic keeps it, who can access it, Anthropic's no-training and ownership commitments, and the controls available to your organization.

skills.label: Manage Claude Science on devices
skills.desc: Claude Science is a desktop application that stores member content locally.

skills.label: Monitor Claude Science usage
skills.desc: Claude Science uses the same seat as the rest of claude.ai. Track its adoption and usage in Analytics and through the Admin API.

skills.label: Network requirements
skills.desc: The domains Claude Science connects to, grouped for a proxy or firewall allowlist: the app's connections to Anthropic, the analysis sandbox's package and research domains, the domains a package mirror adds and removes, and the built-in list of domains it always blocks.

skills.label: Use Claude Science on a corporate network
skills.desc: How to run Claude Science behind an outbound proxy, a TLS-inspecting proxy, an internal package mirror, and an egress firewall, with the settings your network team needs for each.

skills.label: Cloud storage
skills.desc: Connect Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage, or Azure Blob Storage so Claude can read data and write results in place, with your permission.

skills.label: Compute providers
skills.desc: Claude Science can run jobs on an external cloud provider you control, and connect to model servers that serve scientific models over HTTP.

skills.label: Connectors and skills
skills.desc: Connectors give Claude access to external data sources during an analysis.

skills.label: Custom connectors
skills.desc: Add any Model Context Protocol (MCP) server as a Remote (HTTPS web server) or Local command (program on your computer).

skills.label: Literature access
skills.desc: Claude retrieves open-access full text without credentials; add publisher keys or a library proxy to reach paywalled text you're entitled to.

skills.label: Remote compute clusters
skills.desc: Connect a machine you can reach over SSH (a lab workstation or an HPC login node) so Claude can run jobs on it.

skills.label: Run on a remote Linux server
skills.desc: Install Claude Science on a cloud VM or lab server and use it from your own browser through an SSH tunnel.

skills.label: Tools and environments
skills.desc: Claude writes and runs Python, R, and shell commands.

skills.label: A first finite-element model: a clamped steel ruler bends and vibrates
skills.desc: Split a 300 mm steel ruler clamped at one end into 4 beam elements and check its bending under 1 N and its first 3 vibration modes against beam theory.

skills.label: A first Kaplan–Meier curve: the 1963 leukemia trial of 6-MP
skills.desc: Compare 6-MP against placebo with Kaplan–Meier curves from 42 remission times typed into the prompt.

skills.label: A first X-ray diffraction pattern: why silicon shows 6 peaks and salt 9
skills.desc: Simulate the X-ray powder patterns of silicon and table salt and label every peak with Bragg's law.

skills.label: A titration curve from the full equilibrium: which indicator finds the equivalence point?
skills.desc: Solve the full equilibrium for 25.0 mL of 0.100 M acetic acid as 0.100 M NaOH is added, without the usual shortcuts.

skills.label: Example gallery
skills.desc: Browse nine example prompts from nine fields of science, each the start of a complete analysis in Claude Science.

skills.label: Genetic drift in a bottle: Buri's 107 fruit-fly populations
skills.desc: Simulate 107 bottles of 16 fruit flies drifting by chance alone and compare them with Peter Buri's real bottles (1956).

skills.label: PageRank on a web of 11 pages: why 1 good link beats 6 weak ones
skills.desc: Follow a random surfer on Wikipedia's 11-page example until the numbers settle, and reproduce all 11 published values to 0.1 point.

skills.label: Schelling's segregation model: ask for 30% same-color neighbors, end up with 75%
skills.desc: Ask for 30% same-color neighbors, end up with about 75%: the textbook computer version of Thomas Schelling's 1971 idea.

skills.label: The double slit, one electron at a time
skills.desc: Rebuild the picture of Tonomura's 1989 experiment with an ideal double slit: each electron lands as 1 random dot, yet fringes 10.7 µm apart build up.

skills.label: The Ulam spiral: are the primes' diagonal streaks real?
skills.desc: Compare the share of primes per diagonal on Ulam's 1963 spiral of 1 to 40,401 against as many random odd numbers.

skills.label: Artifacts in Claude Science
skills.desc: Artifacts in Claude Science are files Claude saves into a project, such as figures, datasets, and reports. Open, version, trace, and delete them.

skills.label: Auto mode
skills.desc: Auto mode lets Claude Science run code and call connectors without stopping to ask about every step.

skills.label: Claude Science
skills.desc: Anthropic's AI workbench for rigorous science.

skills.label: Claude Science in its own window on macOS
skills.desc: Keep working when Claude Science switches to its own window on a Mac: open, quit, and update it, and turn macOS permissions back on.

skills.label: Comments
skills.desc: Comments in Claude Science pin a note to a specific part of an artifact, such as selected text or a point on a figure, and send the note to Claude.

skills.label: Core concepts
skills.desc: A project groups related sessions and the artifacts they produce.

skills.label: Get started
skills.desc: Install Claude Science on macOS, Windows, or Linux, sign in with your Claude account, and run your first analysis.

skills.label: The reviewer
skills.desc: A built-in verification step that independently re-reads Claude's recent responses, the approved plan, saved artifacts, and the execution record, then checks whether its claims match what ran.

skills.label: Update Claude Science
skills.desc: Install the latest version of Claude Science on Mac, Windows, or Linux, and get past an Update required message or an update that fails.

skills.label: Use Claude Science on more than one computer
skills.desc: What to expect when you sign in on another computer, or under another sign-in on the same computer.

skills.label: Claude Science changelog
skills.desc: Release notes for Claude Science, including new features, improvements, and bug fixes by version.

skills.label: Command line settings
skills.desc: Reference for the claude-science command: its subcommands, the serve flags, the single-use login link, and the environment variables you can set.

skills.label: Configuration file reference
skills.desc: Claude Science's config.toml file: where it lives, how it interacts with Settings, and its network, web search, and upload keys.

skills.label: Glossary
skills.desc: One-sentence definitions for the terms you meet in Claude Science, from artifact to workspace.

skills.label: Legal and compliance
skills.desc: Legal agreements, compliance certifications, and security information for Claude Science.

skills.label: Safeguards
skills.desc: What happens when a model's safeguards flag a message, how to switch models automatically, and how to choose a use case under the Life Sciences Verification Program (beta).

skills.label: Troubleshoot Claude Science
skills.desc: Fix errors you see while using Claude Science: being signed out, capacity retries, Agent Failed, environment setup, connectors, git, dictation, and updates.
